items.title: Edit and generate vectors with the Figma agent
items.excerpt: The Figma agent can now:Use style references to generate vector illustrations and iconsUtilize strokes for line work so you can adjust the weight or end caps...
items.rationale: New Figma agent capability: style-referenced vector and icon generation with editable strokes, which designers can use in their files right away.

items.title: Transform a quick drawing into a live app with Gemini.
items.excerpt: Turn your sketches into functional apps using Gemini. Upload your drawings to the Canvas tool to generate and refine code instantly. Try it now.
items.rationale: Primary-source launch: Gemini Canvas turns paper sketches into working app code, making it quicker to go from a sketch to a prototype.

items.title: Autodesk's most ambitious AI play yet
items.excerpt: Autodesk AI vision goes beyond faster tools: a connected Assistant that decides how to solve tasks on your behalf.
items.rationale: AU 2026 announcements: Autodesk's connected agentic Assistant and AutoAssemble demo, a new direction for CAD/product design work.

items.title: Making Immersive LLM Chat Experiences More Accessible
items.excerpt: As LLM chat patterns become more widespread, making them accessible is essential to ensuring everyone can access the information, tools, and opportunities they offer. Drawing on his work improving these interfaces, Eric Bailey shares practical ways to make chat-based experiences on the web more acce
items.rationale: Practical accessibility patterns from Eric Bailey for LLM chat UIs that teams can apply straight to the AI interfaces they are designing.

items.title: What AI has changed in Design Systems, and what is still up to us
items.excerpt: Design leaders argue AI can now spin up a component kit in minutes, but consistency across teams stays human work; a field study found 20 of 21 open-source design systems ship an MCP server while only 3 wire up Figma Code Connect.
items.rationale: Field data (20 of 21 open-source design systems ship MCP, only 3 use Code Connect) that design-system teams can use to decide what to build next.
